note: What comfy/setup.ps1 installs when nobody names a manifest of their own.
Every revision here is a full 40-character commit id, because a tag or a
branch can be moved to a different commit by whoever owns the repository,
and then the same manifest stops describing the same installation.
revisionLabel is for people to read and is never checked out.
customNodes is empty on purpose: which custom nodes a workflow needs is the
user's decision, and LocalCanvas ships nobody's node set. Add entries here,
or keep your own copy at config/local/comfy-bootstrap.json, which is
gitignored and takes precedence over this file.
See config/examples/comfy-bootstrap.example.json for the entry shape.
THE THREE PROFILES are minimal, recommended and video. There is no full and
no everything. -Profile Minimal is the default and installs a
LocalCanvas-compatible ComfyUI runtime and nothing else; ComfyUI on its own
answers /system_stats and /object_info and serves its own editor, which is
all LocalCanvas asks of it, so no model is intrinsically required and
minimal downloads none. A models entry that claims the minimal profile is
refused when this file is read, so that is true of your manifest as well as
of this one.
models is empty on purpose, and this is a deliberate decision rather than a
gap left to fill in later. A models entry must carry either a sha256 or the
words "verification": "none", and a hash can only be obtained by
downloading the file it describes. Shipping entries with no hash would make
the default install of this repository download unverified multi-gigabyte
files from URLs nobody here has checked -- which is exactly the failure
seen in a reference bootstrap stack examined before this layer was written,
where the one downloader the bootstrap actually called verified
nothing over a registry of 42 hashless entries. So this file ships the
format and not an inventory. Put the models you want in your own manifest,
with their hashes; the example file shows every field.
Nothing in this file is downloaded without -InstallModels, and nothing is
downloaded under -InstallModels either until setup.ps1 has printed what,
how big, from where and under what licence, and you have said yes.
